entries.title: Surface
entries.description: Shell, Panel, Inset, IconTile and ShellHeader — the borderless layers every component is framed with.

entries.title: Action Button
entries.description: Silver primary, secondary, quiet and danger buttons in two sizes, with icons, loading and icon-only buttons.

entries.title: Choice Controls
entries.description: Switch, borderless Checkbox with a mixed state, and a RadioGroup with arrow-key navigation.

entries.title: Status Pill
entries.description: Tinted status pills in five tones with icon or dot, plus a mono Tag for models, branches and transports.

entries.title: Segmented Control
entries.description: Radio-style segmented switch with a sliding active pill that jumps instantly from the keyboard.

entries.title: Progress Bar
entries.description: Progress and meter bars in five tones with optional stripes, plus a stacked SegmentedBar.

entries.title: Rolling Number
entries.description: Odometer-style number: each digit rolls to its new value, units and separators stay put.

entries.title: Text Field
entries.description: Borderless TextField, SearchField with clear and TextArea, with label, description and error wiring.

entries.title: Tooltip
entries.description: Hint anchored to its trigger: scales in from the trigger side, opens instantly once one is warm.

entries.title: Action Menu
entries.description: Dropdown and right-click menus — items with icons and shortcuts, submenus, checkable items and a destructive group.

entries.title: Popover Panel
entries.description: A panel anchored to its trigger — grows from it, closes on outside click or Esc, keeps focus inside.

entries.title: Modal Sheet
entries.description: Centered dialog and edge sheet (drawer) — focus trap, scroll lock, Esc and backdrop to close.

entries.title: Toast Stack
entries.description: Notifications that stack, expand on hover, pause while hovered, swipe or click to dismiss, with actions.

entries.title: Select Field
entries.description: Select and searchable combobox — options with icons and hints, groups, keyboard typeahead.

entries.title: Tab Panels
entries.description: Tabs with panels — sliding indicator, keyboard navigation, lazy panels and counts.

entries.title: Disclosure
entries.description: Accordion and single collapsible sections with smooth height animation.

entries.title: Agent Avatar
entries.description: Avatars for agents and people — initials or image, presence and activity state, stacked groups.

entries.title: Loading Skeleton
entries.description: Placeholders for answers, lists and cards while they load.

entries.title: Range Slider
entries.description: Single and range sliders with steps, marks and value labels — for temperature, length, budgets.

entries.title: Key Hint
entries.description: Keyboard shortcut hints that adapt to the platform — Cmd on Mac, Ctrl elsewhere.

entries.title: Loader
entries.description: Spinner and thinking indicators in a few sizes, with an accessible label.

entries.title: Empty State
entries.description: Empty, no-results and error states with an icon, message and actions.

entries.title: Date Field
entries.description: Calendar and date picker — month grid, ranges, keyboard navigation and min / max.

entries.title: Drop Zone
entries.description: Drag-and-drop file target for a chat — accepts types and size limits, shows why a file was rejected.

entries.title: AI Chat
entries.description: A complete chat app screen — history sidebar, a thread with tool calls, cited answers and feedback, follow-up chips and a composer with a context meter.

entries.title: Coding Agent
entries.description: An agent working in a repo — chat with plan and permission requests on one side, file changes, terminal and a live preview on the other.

entries.title: Data Answer
entries.description: An analytics question answered with KPI cards, a chart and a table, plus follow-up questions to dig further.

entries.title: Booking Assistant
entries.description: An assistant that acts — compares options, picks a time, fills a form and confirms before it books.

entries.title: Agent Console
entries.description: A team view of agents in production — background runs, a trace, eval results, usage and rate limits.

entries.title: Support Widget
entries.description: A support bot embedded on a website — launcher bubble, quick replies, order lookup, handoff to a human and a rating at the end.

props.name: onRate

entries.title: Handoff Inbox
entries.description: Where people take over from the bot — escalated conversations by urgency, what the bot already did, reply and hand back.

entries.title: Streaming Message
entries.description: Assistant message with token streaming, collapsible reasoning, citation chips and copy / retry actions.

entries.title: Agent Status
entries.description: Live activity line for a working agent — current step, rotating detail, elapsed time and a stop action.

entries.title: Message Branches
entries.description: Switch between regenerated answers and edited prompts — arrows, a mini branch map, and direction-aware swaps.

entries.title: Response Feedback
entries.description: Thumbs up or down under an answer; a down vote opens reason chips and a note, then settles into a thank-you.

props.name: onSubmit

entries.title: Agent Composer
entries.description: Prompt input with Ask / Plan / Act modes, a context tray with token counts and messages that queue while the agent works.

entries.title: Agent Question
entries.description: Agent asks with choice cards, marks its own suggestion and reason, and accepts a pick, several picks or free text.

entries.title: Tool Approval Queue
entries.description: Triage pending tool calls by risk: select several, grant once, for the session or always, and undo from the resolved log.

props.name: onDecide
props.sourceType:
(
    requests: ToolApprovalRequest[],
    decision: ToolDecision,
    scope: GrantScope,
  ) => void

entries.title: Tool Call Block
entries.description: Inline chat card for a tool call: name, collapsible JSON args, status, duration and a result preview.

entries.title: File Changes
entries.description: Split review: a file tree on one side, hunks on the other — keep or revert each hunk, then apply the result.

props.name: onHunkChange
props.sourceType: (fileId: string, hunkId: string, keep: boolean) => void

entries.title: Terminal Output
entries.description: Streaming command output with stdout / stderr lines, exit status, duration, copy and stop.

entries.title: MCP Servers
entries.description: Connected MCP servers with status, auth prompts and reconnect — expand one to switch individual tools on or off.

props.name: onToggleTool
props.sourceType: (serverId: string, tool: string, enabled: boolean) => void

entries.title: Background Agents Panel
entries.description: Agents working in the background as a grid of live tiles or a compact dock that expands into the selected agent.

entries.title: Checkpoint Timeline
entries.description: Checkpoints the agent made along the way — scrub through turns, see what changed, restore to any point.

entries.title: Run Trace
entries.description: Flame graph of an agent run with click-to-zoom spans, plus a breakdown of where time, tokens and cost went.

entries.title: Eval Results
entries.description: An eval run as a grid of cases — pass, fail or regressed vs the baseline — with per-case input, expected and actual.

props.name: data

entries.title: Context Window Meter
entries.description: Token usage by segment — system, history, files, tools — with a near-limit warning and a compact action.

props.name: data
props.sourceType: { limit: number; segments: ContextSegment[]; model?: string }

entries.title: Memory Panel
entries.description: What the agent remembers about the user and project — search, scopes, inline edit and forget.

entries.title: Usage Summary
entries.description: Tokens and cost over time, split by model, against a monthly budget.

props.name: data

entries.title: Rate Limits
entries.description: Requests and tokens per minute as refilling buckets, with a retry-after countdown and queued calls when throttled.

props.name: data

entries.title: Chat Thread
entries.description: The conversation itself — user and assistant turns, grouping, date dividers, unread marker and a jump-to-latest pill.

entries.title: User Message
entries.description: A sent prompt with attachments, edit-in-place and resend, copy, and a delivery state.

entries.title: Conversation List
entries.description: Chat history for a sidebar — search, pinned and dated groups, rename inline, archive and delete with undo.

entries.title: Prompt Suggestions
entries.description: Starter prompts for an empty chat and follow-up chips under an answer.

entries.title: Attachment Preview
entries.description: Images and files attached to a prompt — thumbnails, type and size, upload progress, retry and remove.

entries.title: Code Block
entries.description: Code in an answer — filename, language, line numbers, wrap toggle, copy and collapse for long snippets.

entries.title: Source List
entries.description: Citations behind an answer — numbered footnotes with hover previews and a panel of every source used.

entries.title: Chart Card
entries.description: A chart the agent answers with — bar, line, area or donut, with tooltips, legend toggles and animated data.

entries.title: Dot Histogram
entries.description: A distribution as stacked dots — every sample visible, median and p95 marked, samples past a limit such as a timeout flagged.

entries.title: Tick Gauge
entries.description: A meter drawn as ticks around an arc, with a target marker and the shortfall to it in red — success rates, SLOs, budgets.

entries.title: Mirror Strips
entries.description: Rows of dot strips with two series mirrored around a line — compare rounds or weeks on one axis, with pinned columns and notes.

props.name: series

entries.title: Radial Dots
entries.description: A cycle as rings of dots — hours of the day or days of the week, stacked by series, with the headline in the middle.

entries.title: Match Field
entries.description: A fit field — candidates, bots or options placed by score around a centre, grouped into sectors, with threshold rings.

entries.title: Radar Chart
entries.description: Scores across several axes as a polygon, with a dashed bar to meet and each member's values as dots on the spokes.

entries.title: Diverging Bars
entries.description: Stacked daily columns with one series hanging below zero on its own scale — triaged vs escalated, solved vs handed off.

entries.title: Blast Radius
entries.description: What a key, agent or tool can reach, hop by hop around a centre, with the affected paths in red.

props.name: center
props.sourceType: { label: string; initials?: string; icon?: Icon }

entries.title: Iso Bars
entries.description: Isometric stacked bars in two rows — the main volume behind, rework or failures in front.

props.name: aside

entries.title: Hex Density
entries.description: A density map of two measures in hexagons, split by a threshold line — retrieved vs dropped, fast vs slow.

entries.title: Data Table
entries.description: Tabular results — sortable columns, filter, pagination, row selection and copy as CSV.

entries.title: Stat Grid
entries.description: KPI cards with rolling numbers, deltas and sparklines for a quick summary answer.

entries.title: Form Card
entries.description: A form the agent asks the user to fill — fields, selects, validation and a submitted state.

props.name: data
props.sourceType: { title: string; description?: string; fields: FormField[] }

entries.title: Result Carousel
entries.description: A row of result cards — image, title, meta and an action — with snap scrolling and arrows.

entries.title: Slot Picker
entries.description: Pick a time the agent proposed — days, free slots, time zone and a confirm step.

props.name: data
props.sourceType: { title?: string; slots: Slot[]; timeZone: SlotZone; attendeeZone?: SlotZone }

entries.title: Confirmation Card
entries.description: A summary of what the agent is about to do — line items, totals and confirm or edit before it acts.

props.name: data

entries.title: JSON Viewer
entries.description: Structured output as a collapsible tree — types, counts, search, copy path and copy value.

entries.title: Artifact Panel
entries.description: A side canvas for what the agent made — live preview and source tabs, version history and download.

props.name: data
props.sourceType: { title: string; kind: string; versions: ArtifactVersion[] }
